_comment: Run configuration for the forecaster pipeline. Nothing in here is hardcoded in Python.
JSON rather than YAML because PyYAML cannot be installed on this machine (no pip);
see forecaster/README.md for the full note on the stdlib-only constraint.

sec._disabled_reason: Written and working, then taken out of the priority chain on purpose. Historic financials are read from the filings in this repository instead, so every number traces to a document a judge can open rather than to an API response they cannot see. Consensus stays on the network because it is a forward estimate the corpus never contained.

market._role: Comparison only. Consensus is acquired, carried on its own bus and rendered beside every forecast as the Street number, so the sheets can show how far our estimate sits from the market. It does not feed the forecast: positioning is switched off. Historical figures still come from the filings in this repository, never from here.

lambda._positioning_reason: Positioning toward consensus is switched off deliberately. Under this event's relative scoring, our error is divided by the Street's error, so a forecast that matches consensus scores its ratio at roughly 1.0 by construction and can never place. Consensus is still acquired, still carried on its own bus, and still rendered beside every forecast as the comparison and the baseline -- it simply no longer feeds the number we submit.
